user.title: Choose an authentication method
user.description: The Intradel login form is protected by a reCAPTCHA that can reject a plain login/password request. If that happens, log in once in a regular browser and use its session cookie instead.

cookie.description: Log in at https://www.intradel.be/particulier/ in a regular browser, then copy the value of the "Cookie" request header (e.g. from the browser's network inspector) and paste it here.
cookie.title: Session cookie for intradel

reauth_cookie.description: The stored session cookie was rejected. Log in again in a regular browser and paste a fresh session cookie.
reauth_cookie.title: Re-authenticate with Intradel
